why_it_is_an_n_plus_one: FindDriverIDs returns a list, then driver/server.go loops GetDriver once per ID. The siblings never overlap and their durations sum to the elapsed window, so every call is paid for serially.
notes: Two of the 13 siblings carry status ERROR with a 'Retrying GetDriver after error' event. HotROD fails one Redis call on every dispatch, so an error-free group does not exist. The retries are kept: a real N+1 has them.
Trimmed to the sibling group, its parent, and the ancestry to the trace root. 16 spans.
